notes.title: 0.5.7.1 update
notes.notes:
[h1][u][i][b]Alpha 0.5.7.1 is live![/b][/i][/u][/h1][p][/p][p]Are you in [url="https://discord.gg/Ngee6X93bj"]THE PITCH Discord[/url] yet? Opt in to early playtesting, receive updates, kick it with a cool and funny community, give suggestions, life advice, share cat pics, your opinion on Voodoo Chips, etc[/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/Ngee6X93bj" style="button"]Join THE PITCH Discord[/url][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Changes/Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Various networking and host migration bugfixes[/p][/*][*][p]Menu tweaks; some previews of modes to come (!)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tutorial[/b] (version 0.1) added to [b]Training[/b] section. Please let me know if you break it and [i]please[/i] share with me how![/p][/*][*][p]Sometimes movement would feel frustrating or unexpected with collisions with head or feet on some objects, so the standard [b]capsule height[/b] for the player is now [b]shorter[/b] for less collision with head and feet[/p][/*][*][p][b]Grabbing [/b]players can now get [b]stunned[/b] from [b]attacks[/b] by [b]grabbed[/b] players. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Grabbing[/b] players will also get [b]stunned[/b] if they are brought to a [b]wall[/b] or [b]buoy[/b] and knocked off the grabbed player - even if they're on the same team. No more hitching a ride forever![/p][/*][*][p]Player in-game [b]nametags[/b] are now hidden behind objects and the ball. The shape of the nametag is less rounded (for now) but functionally, it's no longer obstructing in-game objects.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b][u][url="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KBa1sF7afvg"]Check out the new Alpha Announcement Trailer on Youtube![/url][/u][/b][/h3][p][/p][h3][b]In the works:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]A main menu party/lobby system[/p][/*][*][p]More host migration tweaks and fixes[/p][/*][*][p]Crash logs[/p][/*][*][p]Post game replay/in-game instant replay[/p][/*][*][p]Spectator mode[/p][/*][*][p]More training modes[/p][/*][*][p]Much more!


[url="https://discord.gg/Ngee6X93bj" style="button"]See the full roadmap in THE PITCH Discord![/url][/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Latest Update
notes.notes:
0.5.5 is live
[list]
[*] major network updates for spawning after a goal/resetting a faceoff
[*] more air control. airborne acceleration 300 -> 450, over max speed deceleration 300 -> 350, braking deceleration airborne unchanged at 20.
[*] major punching/combat overhaul, added some different combat animations to the punch right to toy around with
[*] new player stunned vfx
[*] in game and front end music player bug fixes
[*] solved issues with hand thruster visual bugs
[*] various bug/edges cases with color assignments at game start
[*] fixed (lack of) collision bug with goal posts
[*] fixed control bug where player would occasionally not turn to where the camera is pointing when first aiming
[*] fixed audio bug where thruster sound occurred when entering directional input while aiming
[*] slightly bigger arena
[*] adjusted node, goal, goal screen, defense zone, and dust particle locations and sizes to fit bigger arena
[*] update faceoff locations
[*] fixed camera interpolation to be more responsive when aiming while air dashing
[*] general character orient while aiming improvements
[*] added new kits to the locker room
[/list]

Be sure to join the Discord to get the latest updates sooner, and be involved in alpha testing. Help shape the direction of this game with an awesome community of cool people!
